_about: Cost of one OCR call per route, the input route_ocr_v1.py prices cells with (#6740, .claude/docs/quality-research-system.md §3a). Data, not code: change a fee or a share here and re-run the router. Kinds: paid_api = list price per page; subscription = the share of the plan's quota one call uses (from the meters, scripts/eval/estimator/ocr/meter_quota_share.py), priced at run time by the PRIVATE plan-fee file route_ocr_v1.py --fees reads (ops cost ledger; never committed here, so this file and the committed results carry quota shares, not dollars); gpu = $0 on an idle card, busy_usd_per_1k when the card is busy (the compute-basis figure from scripts/eval/ocr-engine-gpu-costs.json, a stand-in for the queue delay it causes); free = no marginal cost. `engine` is the engine name in the estimator's table. `enabled: false` keeps a route in P(best) but never routes to it.

fees._note: Plan fees are private (Derek, 2026-10-24). route_ocr_v1.py --fees <file> reads agy_month_usd and claude_usd_per_weekly_point from the private fee file (on the job box: /root/claude-jobs/est-v1-6740/plan-fees.json). Without --fees the router stops.

quota_shares.agy_derivation: 2026-10-27 (scripts/eval/experiments/2026-10-27-agy-quota-pool-6740.md): read from the quota itself. `agy -p "/quota" --output-format json` returns the Gemini group's weekly and 5-hour remaining_fraction and spends no tokens. One weekly window (2026-10-23T21:59:44Z to 10-30T21:59:44Z) used 0.2895 of the week on 30,103 calls across all four boxes and the laptop: 30,018 3.8 Flash (29,717 low), 85 Argon. That is 9.6e-6 of a week per Flash-low call (~104K calls/week) = 2.25e-6 of a 30-day allowance. A 10-minute reading the same morning gave 1.5e-5 a week (~66K/week, share 3.5e-6), but readings minutes apart move up and down, so the cross-day figure is the one used. Google prices the pool by token cost (the CLI's own text), so an Argon call costs more than a Flash call; Argon was deliberately not measured (Derek, 2026-10-27). SUPERSEDED reading, kept for the record: meter_quota_share.py over /root/agy-quota/calls.csv, 2026-10-13T07:01 to 2026-10-24T05:30 (10.94 days): 83,551 calls succeeded and 1,936 hit the cap (so the stretch used the whole allowance) = 229,190 calls per 30 days. Cross-check: median 1,578 calls in the 5 h before a 429 burst = 227,232 per 30 days. Every agy model is counted as one call of one pool, as the meter counts them. A second reading, the median calls in the 24 h before a lock (status.json past_bursts prev24h: 5,771), gives 173K per 30 days: the share is between 4.4e-6 and 5.8e-6 a call.
quota_shares.unused_quota_note: 1.0 = a call is worth its full share. Quota left unused at a reset is worth nothing, so near a reset with quota to spare this falls toward 0 (set it per run).
quota_shares.claude_pricing: Per PAGE and per model (Derek, 2026-10-26, #6740): the old 0.0303 points a call, from 66 Sonnet TEXT calls, priced Opus as Sonnet and an image call as a text call. Each Claude route now carries claude_points_per_page; null = UNMETERED, never routed on cost. Opus and Sonnet image OCR are unmetered until job route-judge-run-6740 posts points per image call on #6740. Measured Opus rates, for the stages that use them (estimator v2, scripts/eval/estimator/chain/capacity.json): correction (correct.mjs, 10 pages a call) 1% of an account-week per 250 Latin pages = 0.004 points a page (#5924, 2026-10-24); translation (10 pages a call) 3% per 3,250 pages = 0.00092 points a page (#7263).
